statement: Improve CORAL, a non-Transformer causal kernel / state-space language model, so that wikitext word perplexity measured by the fixed lm-eval protocol decreases without adding self-attention or transformer blocks.
subfield: causal kernel and state-space language modeling
source_paper: CORAL dense causal-kernel language model (internal prototype)

remote.setup: export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.8; export PATH="$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$CUDA_HOME/lib64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"; export PYTHONPATH="$PWD${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"

constraints: Keep CORAL a non-Transformer model: no self-attention, transformer blocks, or pretrained transformer backbone
Evaluate with the official lm-eval wikitext task and report word_perplexity (lower is better)
Use the same tokenizer, context length, evaluation split, and effective training budget for every candidate
Do not train on wikitext test data or add extra evaluation data
The GPU server is offline: use preinstalled packages and local data/model caches
Do not modify bench/rsi_coral_train_eval.py or the benchmark protocol

directions.title: causal state mixing
directions.description: Improve the causal kernel, convolutional history, retention, and selective state mixing while keeping the model non-Transformer.

directions.title: non-Transformer architecture capacity
directions.description: Improve width, depth, expansion, local kernel size, and dense FFN capacity without adding attention.

directions.title: language-modeling objective
directions.description: Improve the causal language-modeling loss or auxiliary regularization while preserving the evaluation protocol.

directions.title: optimization and data recipe
directions.description: Improve the optimizer, learning-rate schedule, precision, sequence packing, or data ordering at a fixed token budget.

forbidden: changing the lm-eval wikitext task or word_perplexity metric
changing the tokenizer or evaluation split
audience_note: External target: snapshot the authorized current dense stack, not old HEAD, into isolated rsi-bench. Production budget comes from stages/pretrain-dense-158m-025b.json (954 steps, effective batch 256, sequence 1024). No baseline is asserted for this snapshot; only a successful real train/evaluate run may populate word_ppl. Explicit limited subset smoke is plumbing evidence, not a full-protocol score.
